rule_title: TTP for Pktmon.exe Abuse for traffic sniffing.
description: Detects WMIImplant writing to CrashControl registry keys via wmiprvse.exe. WMIImplant abuses the CrashControl hive as covert storage for exfiltrated data — network config, system info, and command output are encoded and written to values like DumpFile. wmiprvse.exe has no legitimate reason to modify CrashControl settings.
